claims: The Cincinnati Reds opened the 2026 MLB season at home on Thursday, March 26, 2026.
The Cincinnati Reds lost 3-0 to the Boston Red Sox.
The game was at Great American Ball Park, Cincinnati, OH.
Garrett Crochet earned the win for the Boston Red Sox.
Garrett Crochet allowed three hits over six innings.
Rookie Sal Stewart recorded three of the Cincinnati Reds' four hits in his debut.
First pitch was at 4:10 p.m. ET.
Andrew Abbott was the starting pitcher for the Cincinnati Reds.
Garrett Crochet was the starting pitcher for the Boston Red Sox.
The 107th Findlay Market Opening Day Parade took place in the morning.
The 107th Findlay Market Opening Day Parade ended around 2 p.m.
The Boston Red Sox secured their first opening day shutout since 2015.
Local authorities addressed large crowds at The Banks entertainment district following the game.
